messages:
Nina Park: Kickoff for webinar + launch posts SEO checklist. Need keywords, schema, redirects, and internal-link plan. Who wants what? :rocket:
Owen Blake: I'll handle keyword-to-URL mapping and H1/H2 recommendations. Top targets: "llm inference platform", "inference cost optimization", "dedicated GPU inference".
Tina Rao: I'll own JSON-LD and schema validation. Proposing Event + SoftwareApplication on demo page. Will post snippet.
Samir Khan: I'll compile redirects and legacy promo URLs into a CSV and coordinate with eng-ops for Netlify edge rules. Proposed short examples:
```
/old-webinar -> /events/webinar-q2-2026 301
/blog/old-launch -> /blog/launch-q2-2026 301
/signup-now -> /signup 302
```
Nina Park: Good. Also internal linking: link all blog launch posts back to /products/inference and include primary KW in anchor text where natural. Keep canonical on product page.
Tina Rao: JSON-LD draft: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Q2 Demo","startDate":"2026-04-07T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/events/webinar-q2-2026"}}
```
Owen Blake: I'll create a small brief for writers with meta templates and sample H1/H2s. Share redirect CSV link when ready.
deploy-bot: Reminder: content freeze starts 18:00 PDT today for tomorrow's deploy. Please finalize URLs before freeze.
